study.title: Dapagliflozin in Patients with Heart Failure and Reduced Ejection Fraction
study.condition_studied: Heart Failure with Reduced Ejection Fraction (HFrEF)

eligibility.raw_source_text: New York Heart Association (NYHA) class II, III, or IV symptoms
plasma level of NT-proBNP of at least 600 pg per milliliter (or >=400 if hospitalized within 12 mo)
atrial fibrillation or atrial flutter required NT-proBNP level of at least 900 pg per milliliter
standard heart-failure device therapy and standard drug therapy (ACE inhibitor, ARB, or ARNI plus beta-blocker)
recent treatment with or unacceptable side effects associated with an SGLT2 inhibitor
symptoms of hypotension or a systolic blood pressure of less than 95 mm Hg
eGFR below 30 ml per minute per 1.73 m2 (or rapidly declining renal function)
women of childbearing potential not using contraception, or pregnant or breast-feeding women
coronary revascularization or acute coronary syndrome within 12 weeks before screening
heart transplantation or implantation of a ventricular assist device, or anticipated during trial
all patients provided written informed consent before enrollment

outcomes.parameter_name: Primary Composite (Worsening HF or CV Death)
outcomes.raw_source_text: Primary composite outcome — no. (%) 386 (16.3) vs 502 (21.2); HR 0.74 (0.65 to 0.85); P<0.001

outcomes.parameter_name: Primary Composite (Worsening HF or CV Death)

outcomes.raw_source_text: Total no. of hospitalizations for heart failure and cardiovascular deaths 567 vs 742; Rate Ratio 0.75 (0.65 to 0.88); P<0.001
